_doc: [tunes] The song library (systems/tunes.gd). Files are audio/songs/<id>.mp3; a song whose file is missing is skipped everywhere (no CD, not on the CD player, not in the shuffle), so new MP3s can be dropped in by id later (then run an import). group: story or a planet id. kind: title / cinematic / villain (CD player only unless shuffle), playlist (background shuffle on its planet), night (only at night on its planet), restored (only once its planet is mostly restored). unlock: start (owned from the start) or cd (a CD found in the rubble on found_on). artist: an id in artists. Names, titles, genres, bios and descs are English and translated at display time (tr). artist home: the planet the artist lived on; every intact CD is found on its artist's home planet (found_on). scratched: rare one-play teaser CDs of songs you do not own yet, per_planet of them on each planet (planet/cd_finds.gd). State: GameState.flags.songs {found, pity, pending, scratched (held), scratch_left, scratch_cool, plays}.

artists.name: The Cradle Farewell Orchestra
artists.bio: Played one last concert on the launch pad while the ark boarded. Half of them missed the flight on purpose, so the encore was very long.

artists.name: The Compactors
artists.bio: A four-piece that rehearsed inside a broken trash compactor for the acoustics. They swear the walls only closed in on them once, during a drum solo.

artists.name: Lil' Rustbucket
artists.bio: A retired sweeper bot who refused to stop making beats. Every track was recorded on its own diagnostic beeper, between error codes.

artists.name: DJ Recycle Bin
artists.bio: Only samples sounds from the city dump: lids, crinkles, a fridge door with real soul. Released three albums and never once got out of bed for them.

artists.name: Professor Pianissimo
artists.bio: Composes only for empty rooms and sleeping cities. His neighbours filed forty-one noise complaints, all saying the music was too soft to hear properly.

artists.name: Two Suns Tango Orchestra
artists.bio: Ochre's hardest-working band: with two suns there is no shade and no siesta, so they just kept playing. The sunglasses are part of the uniform.

artists.name: The Mirage Brothers
artists.bio: Nobody is sure how many Mirage Brothers there are. On a hot day the crowd counted seven; on a cold one, just Gary.

artists.name: The Salty Buoys
artists.bio: A beach band that played on floating junk rafts, drifting between islands mid-song. Their tour schedule depended entirely on the tide.

artists.name: Barnacle Bossa Trio
artists.bio: Three mellow players who refused to evacuate until the set was finished. The set was four hours long. They caught the last pod, still humming.

artists.name: Static & the Streetlights
artists.bio: A synth duo who powered their gigs by plugging into whichever harbour lamp still worked. The power company billed them for the whole ice shelf.

artists.name: Mittens McKenzie
artists.bio: Rime's beloved pianist, who played every concert in mittens. Critics called it muffled genius. Mittens called it frostbite prevention.

artists.name: Smelter Skelter
artists.bio: Brooding Anvil band who tuned their drums to the furnace roar. The Ledger tried to buy their catalogue; they melted the contract down and played the slag.

artists.name: Ledger Brand Audio
artists.bio: The Ledger's in-house jingle studio. Every song is copyrighted, trademarked and billed per listen. Credited as "Ledger Brand Audio, all rights extracted".

songs.title: Greenfall (Main Theme)
songs.desc: The song the Makers hummed on the way to the ark. Hopeful, a little lonely.

songs.title: The Fall of LM-1
songs.desc: Meteors, alarms, one small pod falling. Then quiet piano.

songs.title: The Ledger
songs.desc: Ticking clocks and detuned bass. Sounds expensive.

songs.title: Sprout Step
songs.desc: Bright and bouncy, for scooping junk off city streets and pressing it into bales.

songs.title: Clean Sweep
songs.desc: Sunny indie-pop groove for a little robot sweeping an abandoned city back to life.

songs.title: Little Helpers
songs.desc: A crew of small worker robots buzzing around a junkyard base.

songs.title: Neon Gutters
songs.desc: Rusty neon signs flicker over trash-filled streets at sunset.

songs.title: Morning Shift
songs.desc: Early light over a city half-buried in junk as the first robots head out to work.

songs.title: Bale by Bale
songs.desc: Focus music for steady, repetitive cleanup work.

songs.title: Rust and Ribbons
songs.desc: Wandering alone through quiet ruined streets while plants push up through the cracks.

songs.title: Old Town at Rest
songs.desc: Home base at the end of a long day: a repaired workbench, a humming generator, a few robots parked nearby.

songs.title: Verdance Night
songs.desc: Night falls over the junk city and only a few street lamps still glow.

songs.title: Verdance in Bloom
songs.desc: The once trash-covered city is green again: gardens on every corner, birds back in the trees.

songs.title: Sunbaked
songs.desc: Two blazing suns over orange dunes and a giant abandoned strip mine.

songs.title: Strip Mine Shuffle
songs.desc: Hauling scrap out of a terraced mining pit under a white-hot sky.

songs.title: Dune Caravan
songs.desc: A long line of robots crossing rolling dunes, carrying scrap home.

songs.title: Glass Dunes
songs.desc: Wind has polished the sand into glittering glass ridges.

songs.title: Sandglass
songs.desc: A slow hot afternoon, steady work in the shade of a rusted mining crane.

songs.title: Twin Noon
songs.desc: Midday under two suns, heat shimmering over empty land.

songs.title: Mirage Night
songs.desc: Desert night, warm wind, the mine's silhouette against the stars.

songs.title: Oasis Terraces
songs.desc: The old mine pit has become terraced gardens around a bright blue oasis.

songs.title: Tradewinds
songs.desc: Hovering over a turquoise ocean between tiny islands, scooping floating junk out of the waves.

songs.title: Hover Hop
songs.desc: Skimming fast across open water from island to island.

songs.title: Skipping Stones
songs.desc: Sun on the water, gulls overhead, junk bobbing in the surf.

songs.title: Salt and Sails
songs.desc: Old harbour wrecks and rusty buoys along a windy coast.

songs.title: Low Tide Lofi
songs.desc: Slow work on a quiet beach at low tide.

songs.title: Glass Lagoon
songs.desc: A clear shallow lagoon with coral visible under still water.

songs.title: Tidepools
songs.desc: Night on the ocean planet, bioluminescent glow in the waves.

songs.title: Kelp Garden
songs.desc: The seas are clean again: kelp forests, schools of fish, floating island gardens.

songs.title: Snowplow
songs.desc: Pushing through fresh snow on a frozen moon, digging out buried scrap.

songs.title: Hoarfrost
songs.desc: Glassy blue ice plains under a huge ringed planet.

songs.title: Crunch Ice
songs.desc: Steady work inside a heated dome while snow blows outside.

songs.title: Aurora Drift
songs.desc: Green and violet aurora rippling over frozen ridges.

songs.title: Ringlight
songs.desc: A giant ringed gas planet hangs over a frozen crater.

songs.title: Frozen Harbor
songs.desc: An abandoned drilling port locked in ice, snow falling softly.

songs.title: Long Night
songs.desc: The long night on an ice moon far from its suns.

songs.title: Thaw
songs.desc: Warmth returns from deep underground: frozen pools become steaming hot springs and moss spreads over the ice.

songs.title: Red Engine
songs.desc: A red Mars-like foundry world of iron towers and lava rivers, home of the Ledger.

songs.title: Slag Run
songs.desc: Hauling scrap past roaring furnaces and rivers of molten slag.

songs.title: Foundry Heart
songs.desc: Deep inside an abandoned volcanic foundry, like walking through an underworld.

songs.title: Ember Market
songs.desc: A ruined forge city lit by drifting embers.

songs.title: Red Dust Waltz
songs.desc: A dust storm rolls over rusted machines on a red planet.

songs.title: Magma Crawl
songs.desc: Lava slowly creeping across black rock under a blood-red sky.

songs.title: Ash Choir
songs.desc: Ash drifts through red light as night falls on the volcanic world.

songs.title: Iron Bloom
songs.desc: The foundry world restored: flowers growing between cooled lava flows, iron towers wrapped in vines.
